Prerequisite: N/A

When attacking with unarmed strikes or a weapon you are proficient with, you can use your Cursed Energy modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for your attack and damage rolls. However, on a roll of natural one for an attack roll, you must make a Cursed Energy check against your Cursed Energy DC, or shatter the weapon as you overcharge it or take 1 necrotic damage if using unarmed strikes.
Additionally, you can spend 1 cursed energy to imbue it into an object for 1 minute, causing it to deal necrotic damage for the duration.
